review_resolution.item: Blocker 1: diagnostic hooks omit live controller ownership
review_resolution.fix: launch_production.run_branch now supplies controller.active_plans to EpisodePolicy.observe before each apply, including the MixedPolicy isolated path. Audited and fixed launch_evaluation.episode identically. Both use the existing local visible-CAV/original-expiry projection, just like training/practice. Controller commands, ledger, t0 replay, CRN, serial acquisition and full diagnostic windows retain their existing contracts.
review_resolution.regression: test_diagnostic_hooks_refresh_live_controller_ownership: nine A/B/R x lesson/isolated_all/paired cases through actual diagnostic hooks and production policy loaders. Real CPU policies, V2V-wrapped controllers, VerifyController snapshot/CRN restoration, MixedPolicy, balanced candidates, masks and executor; only outer physics/grading replaced. Checks owned ego, free ego with owned partner, newly added live plans, local-only projection, original authoritative commands/expiry, exact-expiry availability, serial same-tick exclusion and exact ownership/family counters.
review_resolution.red_evidence: Before the source fix all six B/R cases failed on empty command_reservations; all three A cases passed. Confirmed red run: 6 failed, 3 passed, 22 deselected. After the fix: 9 passed, 22 deselected.

registration.allocation: One slot per feasible non-none family per randomly permuted cycle; family counts differ by at most one; none is the separate baseline slot.
registration.acquisition: Original controller expiry plus executor commitments, stable ego ID order, acquire before the next slate, original context ordering for PPO replay.
registration.eligibility: Every member including ego must be locally observable, in registered range, currently controlled and unowned by controller or executor.
registration.arms: Common B/R proposal and ownership logic; A/default-off compatibility covered by the passing suites.

api.live_decision: feasible_proposals.decide_and_start(trigger, context, *, obs_states, observable_cavs, executor, now, rng, generator, deterministic=False, command_reservations=None) -> (TriggerBatch, accepted_by_ego, stats)
api.observation_bridge: EpisodePolicy.observe(rows, now, *, command_commitments=()) projects only each ego's visible CAV IDs and original start_s + duration_s expiry. Training/practice, branch diagnostics and paired evaluation supply the current controller.active_plans every apply.
api.command_reservations: ego -> locally visible CAV ID -> original authoritative expiry; available when now == expiry
api.aggregation: feasible_proposals.aggregate(receipts) -> update stats or None if unmeasured
api.update_telemetry: metrics.move_proposals in per-arm per-update learning-monitor JSON
api.infeasible_rate: sum(rejected_non_none) / sum(selected_non_none), or null without selections
api.family_infeasible_rate: sum(infeasible_family_checks) / sum(family_checks), or null without checks
api.ownership_counters: owned_cav_checks counts local controlled occupied CAV slots across serial egos, including same-tick executor acquisitions; controller_owned_cav_checks measures its controller-owned subset. Legacy receipts missing these counters aggregate to null.
api.ppo: Recorded conditional tables, masks, old log probabilities and original context ordering are replayed without regenerating proposals
